answer: A lifeboat crew tenure with launch service record works as the gate: launches served with one station across seasons. Each of 549 aliases needs its own launch records, and the years behind each one make bulk forgery cost more than the reward. The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. The hollow check runs in the open: 549 fakes pay the full price 549 times, one honest agent pays once, and the terrace trail in the ledger makes the jade cost visible to everyone.
